question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing sweeper, Bob is playing benchwarmer, Claire is playing right back, Dave is playing cheerleader, and Eve is playing left midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Bob trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Eve and Claire trade positions. Then, Dave and Bob trade positions. Finally, Claire and Dave trade positions. At the end of the match, Eve is playing
Options:
(A) sweeper
(B) benchwarmer
(C) right back
(D) cheerleader
(E) left midfielder
solution:
Player order in every row: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: sweeper | benchwarmer | right back | cheerleader | left midfielder
1. Eve ↔ Bob: sweeper | left midfielder | right back | cheerleader | benchwarmer
2. Bob ↔ Claire: sweeper | right back | left midfielder | cheerleader | benchwarmer
3. Eve ↔ Claire: sweeper | right back | benchwarmer | cheerleader | left midfielder
4. Dave ↔ Bob: sweeper | cheerleader | benchwarmer | right back | left midfielder
5. Claire ↔ Dave: sweeper | cheerleader | right back | benchwarmer | left midfielder
Eve is playing left midfielder, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
